component.description:
What it does The front door of an orchestration. It accepts whatever the caller sends and passes it into the flow without changing it.

How it works Every orchestration needs exactly one start. This one is deliberately empty of logic: whatever request data and file or document arrive on its external port go out of its output port unchanged. Because it makes no assumptions about the shape of the input, it works for any flow.

Configure The input contract, in the Inspector: declare the fields the caller must send, their types and whether each is required. Saving the orchestration bakes that contract into this node's own copy; the shared template is never changed.

In and out In: the caller's request data and, optionally, a file or document. Out: both, unchanged.

Use it when
- You are building any orchestration and have no special entry requirements.
- You want the caller's payload to reach the first real component untouched.
- You are replacing a hand-written start component that only passed data through.
component.manifest_yaml:
extension_type: start
name: Generic Start (Prebuilt)
description: Passthrough start component. Define input contract via Inspector.
input_ports:
- port_name: external_input
  port_type: external_in
  artifact_type_input: json
  artifact_type_output: json
output_ports:
- port_name: output
  port_type: out
  artifact_type_input: json
  artifact_type_output: optional(json)
  response_data_contract: dynamic
  response_data_contract_reason: 'Passthrough component: response_data is forwarded from the run''s own
    data, whose fields are supplied by the orchestration at run time and cannot be enumerated statically.'
input_parameters: []
input_prompt: Provide the input data for this orchestration.
component.name: GENERIC START (SYSTEM, READ-ONLY)
component.short_description: The default entry point: accepts whatever the caller sends and hands it to the flow unchanged.
